item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo nag mo'i mthu bsgrub kyi gsang ba'i mdos gzhung snang srid rol skong
item.coloph: de ltar gsang mdos phul ba yis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ bon gshen dbu 'phang mtho ba dang / sems can kun la phan bde 'byung / bsam pa bar chad med par 'grub/ sgrib sbyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ mchog thun dngos 'grub tshe 'dir 'byung / bla med sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bstan/ ma 'grib yid la zhog (bzhag) pa na/ rten 'brel dbang gis lo 'ga' la/ btang snyoms dbang gis lus song yang / shar yul bsgrod pa'i dus de ru/ dad ldan bu yis (mchan nyi ma 'od zer) bskul phyir du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa la/ 'gal 'khrul nyes skyon yod gyur na/ ye shes lha dang mkha' 'gror bshags/ dge mchis ma gyur 'gro rnams kun/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig
